SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.question_type AS question_type, q.title AS title, q.difficulty AS difficulty, q.answer AS answer, q.analysis AS analysis, q.create_time AS create_time, q.update_time AS update_time, q.creator_id AS creator_id, q.remarks AS remarks,
kp.kp_name,
qi.id AS image_id, qi.question_id AS image_question_id, qi.image_path, qi.type AS image_type
FROM question q LEFT JOIN question_knowledge qk ON q.id = qk.question_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON qk.kp_id = kp.id LEFT JOIN question_image qi ON q.id = qi.question_id
mapper.select: where q.id = #{id} ORDER BY q.id, kp.id, qi.id

SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.question_type AS question_type, q.title AS title, q.difficulty AS difficulty, q.answer AS answer, q.analysis AS analysis, q.create_time AS create_time, q.update_time AS update_time, q.creator_id AS creator_id, q.remarks AS remarks,
qo.id AS option_id, qo.question_id AS option_question_id, qo.option_label, qo.option_content, qo.is_correct,
kp.id AS kp_id, kp.kp_name, kp.kp_desc,
qi.id AS image_id, qi.question_id AS image_question_id, qi.image_path, qi.description AS image_description
FROM question q LEFT JOIN question_option qo ON q.id = qo.question_id LEFT JOIN question_knowledge qk ON q.id = qk.question_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON qk.kp_id = kp.id LEFT JOIN question_image qi ON q.id = qi.question_id
WHERE q.id = #{id}
ORDER BY qo.id, kp.id, qi.id

SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.question_type, q.title, q.difficulty, q.answer, q.analysis, q.create_time, q.update_time, q.creator_id, q.remarks FROM question q
AND q.question_type = #{questionType} AND q.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') AND q.difficulty = #{difficulty} AND q.creator_id = #{creatorId}
AND q.id IN ( SELECT qk.question_id FROM question_knowledge qk JOIN knowledge_point kp ON qk.kp_id = kp.id WHERE kp.kp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kpName}, '%') )
ORDER BY q.id ASC
